original_test_intent: Use the identified BMC's approved WebUI firmware-update workflow to write an exact BIOS image, then prove task completion, activation/reboot, correct BIOS/OS version and host/BMC health.
original_method: Bind BMC/host/image, validate trusted WebUI or documented equivalent UpdateService schema and task states, preserve baseline, obtain write/reboot approval, upload/select one signed image, monitor the full task without interruption, then verify BIOS Setup, OS/BMC inventory and health.
manual_activity: Owner approves exact BMC/host/image/path/reboot/recovery; operator may drive the required WebUI authorization and BIOS Setup verification. A Redfish path is allowed only if vendor-documented as equivalent.
required_inputs: Signed compatible BIOS .cap/hash and target version
Documented WebUI workflow or equivalent UpdateService schema/action
safety_requirements: Never use curl -k or expose credentials
Do not interrupt active task or power
No short grep as completion proof
No auto-retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Collect WebUI/Redfish audit and OS/BMC health
engineer_actions: Provide stable power and independent recovery
Supervise BIOS Setup and own verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: FirmwareInventory is a useful post-check but the proposed `curl -k`/credential command neither performs nor proves the WebUI flash and suppresses identity/security. Vendor-documented UpdateService task semantics are mandatory.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After exact vendor schema, TLS, image, target, task and recovery approval, run the documented WebUI or equivalent UpdateService operation, monitor its complete terminal/activation states, reboot as required and collect BIOS Setup plus OS/BMC health evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC WebUI method, reboot, BIOS/OS checks and 30/30-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use trusted TLS, protected credentials, immutable image identity, full asynchronous task history and independent recovery rather than a short inventory grep.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authoritative API equivalence, task lifecycle and management security.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Proves actual write/activation and preserves WebUI-method intent when API equivalence is documented.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Vendor task and activation semantics vary; an incorrect path can brick the host or strand management.

project_override_considerations: Project must decide whether a documented Redfish action is accepted as BMC-WebUI equivalent; otherwise the WebUI action remains operator-driven. POST-display row 362 is separate.
expected_evidence: WebUI or authoritative Redfish schema and TLS identity
Approval and protected task URI/status history
Stable power, activation and reboot IDs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Primary fields consistently require BMC WebUI flashing; the private script is only incomplete post-check coverage, and the duplicate POST-display variant is isolated.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The workflow is identifiable; normal image, vendor schema, credentials, approval and recovery are finite prerequisites. Execution stops if equivalence/task semantics cannot be established.

review_improvement: Replaces an insecure, non-probative inventory grep with authoritative task lifecycle, TLS/credential controls and independent activation evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: BMC-mediated flashing can be partly automated, but only through a vendor-defined task model and with explicit write/reboot approval. Because DeepSeek's command neither proves WebUI equivalence nor completion and weakens TLS, its material execution conclusion changes even though the hybrid premise remains.
